instruction: Grab the tabletrashbin made of plastic and pour the balls.

source.instruction: Grab the tabletrashbin made of plastic and pour the balls.

arm_note: ARM CHOICE in this demonstration: the LEFT arm grasped the deskbin, which was at x = -7 (left half of the table). The arm was chosen by the object's x position (x < 0 -> LEFT arm, x > 0 -> RIGHT arm; each arm reaches only ~15 cm past the centre line). In YOUR scene the objects may be on the other side: choose the arm from your own object positions, not from the demonstration.

frames.label: turn 1
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.93; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.93; table z = 74
frames.plan: Move left gripper right towards x=-8 and forward to y=-16, pointing down.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+22, +3, -0) cm, now 1 cm (horizontal) / +20 cm (vertical) from the deskbin

frames.label: turn 2
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-8, -17, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Rotate left yaw +40 degrees and lower slightly by 1 cm to prepare for grasping the rim.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+0, +0, -1) cm, now 1 cm (horizontal) / +19 cm (vertical) from the deskbin

frames.label: turn 3
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-8, -17, 93) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Move gripper down to z=85 and adjust x/y position to align around the bin rim.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (-1, -4, -8) cm, now 4 cm (horizontal) / +11 cm (vertical) from the deskbin

frames.label: turn 4
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-9, -21, 85) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Rotate yaw +60 degrees for optimal grasp angle and close gripper completely.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips stayed in place, now 3 cm (horizontal) / +11 cm (vertical) from the deskbin; closed the gripper (opening 0.07: holding the deskbin)

frames.label: turn 5
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-9, -21, 85) opening 0.07; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lift bin up to z=93 and move y/x back towards center table.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+1, +4, +8) cm, now 3 cm (horizontal) / +11 cm (vertical) from the deskbin

frames.label: turn 6
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-8, -17, 93) opening 0.07; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Rotate yaw +40 degrees to align for transport toward the trash/dump area on the left.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips stayed in place, now 3 cm (horizontal) / +11 cm (vertical) from the deskbin

frames.label: turn 7
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-8, -17, 93) opening 0.07; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lift to z=100, roll wrist to start tilt, and translate left across table to x=-44.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (-36, +0, +7) cm, now 11 cm (horizontal) / +4 cm (vertical) from the deskbin

frames.label: turn 8
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-44, -16, 100) opening 0.08; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Move bin forward along y to y=+6 and adjust yaw/pitch to position directly above the bag.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (-0, +22, -0) cm, now 5 cm (horizontal) / +100 cm (vertical) from the dustbin

frames.label: turn 9
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-45, 5, 100) opening 0.07; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Pitch and roll the wrist sharply to invert the bin and pour out the balls.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips stayed in place, now 5 cm (horizontal) / +100 cm (vertical) from the dustbin

frames.label: turn 10
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-45, 5, 100) opening 0.07; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Raise gripper slightly to ensure all balls have discharged.
